start: Gym timings page, gym online, timings already saved

user_sees: Title 'Gym timings'
'Right now members see: …'
Section 'Every week' with one box per day
'Last saved <day> by <name>.'

An endless 'Loading…'

steps.action: Change Monday's opening time, then tap 'Copy Monday to Tue to Sat'
user_sees: Tuesday to Saturday show Monday's times
Sunday is unchanged
The 'Right now members see' line follows the change
must_not: Sunday changed
Members seeing the change before Save

steps.action: Tap '+ Add a special day', pick the date, leave it Closed, type the reason 'Diwali'
user_sees: 'Special day 1: date'
'Special day 1: why (optional)'
must_not: More than 30 special days allowed
A special day saved for a day already over without a word

user_sees: Button says 'Saving…'
Toast 'Gym timings saved. Members see them in the MettleUp app (Gym tab) within 10 minutes.'
Button says 'Saved ✓'
'These timings are saved (<day>) and members see them. Change any time above to save again.'

Times saved in a different order than members should read them

user_sees: Section 'Start from'
'Pick the one closest to your gym, then change any day.'
A short list of ready-made weeks
must_not: An empty editor with no way to start
The set-up step ticked before anything is saved

user_sees: The editor with every day filled from that choice
'Right now members see: …'
must_not: Anything saved by the tap alone

user_sees: Toast 'Gym timings saved. Members see them in the MettleUp app (Gym tab) within 10 minutes.'
The set-up step 'Set your gym timings' is ticked

Members seeing timings of another branch

start: Gym timings editor open, gym online

steps.action: Set Monday to close before it opens (or make the two times of one day overlap), tap 'Save timings'
user_sees: A red line with the problem in plain words
'Fix the times below to see what members will see.'
must_not: The bad times saved
Members shown a closing time before the opening time
The typed times wiped

steps.action: Correct the time and tap 'Save timings' while the server refuses it
user_sees: 'Your gym’s server could not take these timings. Check each time and try again.'
must_not: The saved toast
The button turning to 'Saved ✓'

start: Owner signed in on this device only (gym not online), or a gym whose server has no timings yet

user_sees: 'Gym timings need your gym online' with 'Members’ phones read the timings from your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
or 'Gym timings are not switched on for your gym yet' with 'They will appear here once your gym’s server has them.'
must_not: An editor that saves nowhere
A blank page

start: Gym timings saved and shown to members

user_sees: Sheet 'Remove the gym timings?'
'Members will no longer see when your gym is open. You can add the timings again at any time.'
Buttons 'Keep them' and 'Remove'
must_not: Timings removed without the question

user_sees: The editor, unchanged
must_not: Anything removed

user_sees: Toast 'Gym timings removed. Members no longer see them.'
The page goes back to 'Start from'
must_not: Members still shown the old timings after 10 minutes
The set-up step still ticked as if timings exist

steps.action: Pick a ready-made week and tap 'Save and show members'
user_sees: Toast 'Gym timings saved. Members see them in the MettleUp app (Gym tab) within 10 minutes.'
must_not: Old special days coming back by themselves

start: Timings saved by the owner; a front-desk login of the same gym opens the page

steps.action: As front desk, open Gym timings
user_sees: 'Your gym’s timings' with the week and the special days, read only
'Only the owner can change the gym timings.'

steps.action: As a member of this gym, open the Gym tab of the MettleUp app within 10 minutes
